headline: Ghana Economy Grows to GH¢1.4 Trillion Amid Job Creation Concerns
summary: Ghana's economy expanded to GH¢1.4 trillion in 2025 with a six percent growth rate, though the statistical service noted the expansion failed to generate sufficient decent jobs.
why: Tracking gross domestic product and employment metrics provides key insights into macroeconomic health and development in West African emerging markets.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Official statistical reporting measures the overall domestic economic output of Ghana.
